title: This is the one tool that actually gets smarter every single time you use it. #ai #aitools #recall
transcript: The smartest people in AI are all doing this one secret thing and you've probably never seen it. They're building personal knowledge bases, basically training the AI on everything they've ever saved, watched, or read. And there's a tool now that basically lets anyone do this in seconds with no technical setup. It's called Recall, and let me show you how it works. So, you can basically save anything that you want, like podcasts, YouTube videos, TikToks, websites, and even PDFs. And then it's automatically going to summarize and organize all of that information for you. So, I was watching this podcast about healthy eating on YouTube, and all I have to do is come up and click on the Recall Chrome extension, and then it's automatically going to store that in my database. But, here's the coolest part. If I come over here and select the Recall chat option, and say something like, "Where did that health podcast talk about sugar?" It will actually pull up that exact moment in the podcast and even give me the timestamp so I can go back and watch it. This could be something that I saved weeks ago, but it's all stored in my knowledge base. You can even choose from all the top AI models like Claude, GPT, and Gemini. And no other AI can do this because no other AI knows what you know. So, if you want to try this out yourself and actually have an AI that gets smarter every single time you use it, comment memory and I'll shoot you over a link.
